# Attempt 8 scope: F1 is fixed in this ticket

Ruud's decision after the return from the attempt 7 review (triage 114, return 115):
F1 (medium) is fixed here. mutation.source_files keeps any path under
packages/core/src whatever its extension, and patterns() treats every non-.ts
entry as a directory, so a slice naming a .json under src can never be measured
and the tdd gate refuses it on every rerun; mutation_ci.select ignores the same
path, so the gate and CI disagree.

The fix, one slice of at most 1 point: source_files keeps only .ts files and
extensionless directories under packages/core/src, the same rule select applies,
with a SourceFilesTest case over a .json path (alone, and beside a .ts file) as the
RED. Files: harness/mutation.py, harness/tests/test_mutation.py, and the ticket file
for the Outcome. mutation_ci.py changes only if the shared rule is factored into one
place.

F3 (CI does not run test:fixtures) is noted only, Ruud's decision. F2 is noted.
F4 (the ticket's summary table says Status doing) is fixed with the attempt 8
Outcome, before review.
